description_en: Calls CreateAutoLiveStreamRule to create an automatic single-stream relay rule
description_zh: 调用CreateAutoLiveStreamRule创建自动旁路单路转推规则
kebab_example: aliyun rtc create-auto-live-stream-rule --app-id eo850000 --play-domain rtmp://_domain_/_app_/_stream --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAutoLiveStreamRule

parameters.help_en: The list of channel IDs that are exactly matched
parameters.name: channel_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of channel ID prefixes that are fuzzy matched
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配频道ID的前缀列表
parameters.name: channel_id_prefixes

parameters.help_en: The application ID, which can be created and queried in the console
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，可通过控制台创建和查询
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The streaming domain name for automatic relay. The streaming URL of an automatic relay task is in the format rtmp://${domain}/${app}/${stream}.

domain: your live streaming domain name.
app: live.
stream: urlencode(${AppId}${ChannelId}${UserId}_${SourceType}), where SourceType indicates the type of the input source
parameters.help_zh:
自动旁路的播流域名。自动旁路任务对应播流地址为rtmp://${domain}/${app}/${stream}。

domain: 您的直播播流域名。
app: live。
stream: urlencode(${AppId}${ChannelId}${UserId}_${SourceType})，其中SourceType为输入源类型
parameters.name: play_domain

parameters.help_en: The name of the relay rule
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The callback URL used to notify the start and end of the relay. For details about the callback content, see the CallBack callback example below
parameters.help_zh: 开启和结束旁路的回调地址。回调内容请参见下文中的CallBack回调示例
parameters.name: call_back

parameters.help_en: The encoding option. For more information, see the MediaEncode enumeration values below
parameters.help_zh: 编码选项，请参见下文中的MediaEncode枚举值
parameters.name: media_encode

RuleId.description_en: The ID of the relay rule
